title: The Last Interior
author: Xanthe Eastwick
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
